history: Turn 1: The keeper carried it to Empty station.
Turn 1: Pip carried it to Empty station.
Turn 1: Vale takes the Halfway Cup.

log.speaker: World
log.text: Vale arrives at the empty station. Pip carries a black cloth. The keeper holds the oil for an empty lamp. Each wants something ... different. Under the pond, a presence is listening.

log.speaker: World
log.text: Vale arrives at Halfway Tea Garden. A tea garden caught on February Second. Carry a memory, prepare a credited show, and help the forest welcome tomorrow.

log.speaker: World
log.text: The keeper goes to Empty station.

log.speaker: World
log.text: The Bard goes to Theban Harbor Road.

log.speaker: World
log.text: The Bard reaches Theban Harbor Road.
